name: Robbie Sieczkowski
bio:
Robbie is a PhD student in Informatics at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, with a focus on Design, Technology and Society. He studies how serious games and immersive technologies are made and how they affect learning, prosocial behavior, and reflection on real-world systems.

He leads production of educational games in the Game Studies and Design program’s student-run studio and contributes to teaching in game studies and cinema production.
